name: calculator_evaluate
description: Calculate a new arithmetic expression in Calculator Agent and display the saved result. Replaces current work. Supports decimals, negatives, + - * /, postfix %, normal precedence; no parentheses. Automatically opens the app. equalsCount includes first equals and repeats the final operation for extra presses.

name: calculator_continue
description: Apply an operator and operand to the current displayed calculator value. suffix starts with + - * /. Supports contextual percentages. Opens app and returns actual result.

name: calculator_state
description: Read the actual current calculator entry, pending expression, error and repeated operation.

name: calculator_history
description: List actual saved calculator history, newest first, including indices, expressions and answers.

name: calculator_recall
description: Recall a saved calculator answer by an index returned from calculator_history. Does not independently recompute it.
